HomePage.heroSubtitle: Precision agronomy intelligence platform engineered for Ethiopian highlands farming, delivering automated crop timing alerts and kebele-level resource coordination.
HomePage.section2Title: The 34 vs. 12 Quintal Reality Timing Over Fortune
HomePage.section2Subtitle: Two adjacent 1-hectare plots in Lume Woreda with identical soil profile and certified seed stock. The documented yield divergence was strictly determined by micro-window intervention timing.

HomePage.section3Title: Empirical Agronomy Measured on Real Farmland
HomePage.section3Subtitle: Every recommendation in AgriIntel is calibrated against real agronomic trials across Ethiopian micro-climates.
HomePage.fieldTrialLabel: Field Trial 4: Lume Woreda, Central Highlands
HomePage.section4Subtitle: Designed specifically for the infrastructural realities and agronomic nuances of the Ethiopian agricultural landscape, from micro-plots to regional grain corridors.
HomePage.pillar1Summary: Delivers agronomic directives via natural voice in local languages, ensuring smallholders without digital literacy can receive and act on time-critical recommendations.
HomePage.pillar2Summary: Instant on-device and cloud diagnosis for over 48 endemic cereal diseases and invasive pests, operating seamlessly even during intermittent rural cellular connectivity.
HomePage.pillar2Prescription: Emergency Triazole spray within 48h before canopy spore saturation.
HomePage.pillar3Summary: Predictive micro-climate forecast engines calculate exact 6-hour windows for fertilizer absorption, spray efficacy, and harvest drying.
HomePage.pillar4Summary: Direct integration with regional cooperative unions and agro-dealers ensures access to verified, certified seeds and genuine crop protection inputs.
HomePage.section5Subtitle: For regions and smallholders without reliable smartphones or internet access, AgriIntel delivers automated voice broadcasts and direct alerts to local Kebele Development Agents.
HomePage.dispatch1Text: Delivered in Afan Oromo to 412 registered wheat farmers: 'High stripe rust risk detected. Postpone morning nitrogen spray until wind speed drops below 6 km/h.'
HomePage.dispatch2Text: Priority dispatch to 6 assigned Development Agents: 'Soil moisture saturation at 84% in Lower Valley. Direct furrow drainage protocol activated across 42 teff hectares.'
HomePage.dispatch3Text: Offline fallback sent to 1,280 smallholders with market price alerts for Adama grain depot and optimal 4-day harvest drying windows.
HomePage.channelList: Ethio Telecom Voice Gateway • Kebele DA Offline Mesh • National Weather Service Sync

HomePage.benchmark3Desc: Zero sensor installation costs. Operates using existing satellite feeds, micro-weather radar, and basic mobile phones.

Landing.heroTitle: Leading Provider Of AI & Field Intelligence For All Farmers.
Landing.heroDesc: Our vision is a thriving Ethiopian agricultural ecosystem with fully predictive advisory, AI disease diagnosis, localized soil telemetry, and automated SMS alerts to maximize national crop yield.
Landing.profFarmersDesc: Committed to building long-lasting partnerships with farming households, founded on verified agronomic advice, trust, and collaboration.
Landing.organicSolutionsDesc: Together, we aim to promote climate-smart agriculture, soil protection, and natural organic farming practices across all agro-ecological zones.
Landing.ourValuesDesc: We believe in responsible farming techniques that prioritize health of our soil, smallholder livelihood, and regional food security.
Landing.aboutTitle: Currently we are growing food security and We’re Best in Smart Agriculture.
Landing.aboutP1: We are the national digital agriculture and precision advisory platform, connecting rural farming households, Kebele extension agents, and regional agricultural bureaus with actionable crop insights.
Landing.aboutP2: The modern farming landscape demands data-driven resilience, which is why our localized soil moisture tracking, pest early warning, and multilingual voice advisories are certified and accurate.
Landing.aboutQuote: Converting non-utilised lands into productive yields and providing agricultural livelihood for farmers and youth, empowering the nation towards self-sufficiency.
Landing.aboutCheck1: Promote sustainable agriculture that protects soil
Landing.aboutCheck2: Support large-scale efficiency with smart solutions
Landing.aboutCheck3: Providing premium diagnostic models with certified accuracy
Landing.servicesTitle: Innovative solutions for agriculture optimal crops growth & soil health.
Landing.servicesDesc: Providing the highest quality of service to our farming communities, and with our approach allow us to meld latest AI and IoT telemetry with indigenous agronomy to maximize the efficiency of operations.
Landing.service1Desc: Hyper-local moisture, soil temperature, and radar-synced rainfall forecasts for optimal planting windows.
Landing.service2Desc: Instant visual computer-vision diagnosis of Wheat Stripe Rust, Maize Blight, and stem borers with certified treatments.
Landing.service3Desc: Bridging the digital divide with automated toll-free voice calls (IVR) and SMS broadcasts in Amharic, Afaan Oromoo, and Tigrinya.
Landing.service4Desc: Real-time Ethiopian Commodity Exchange (ECX) grain pricing, certified seed lot tracking, and union fertilizer quotas.
Landing.impactTitle: Helping farmers in their transition to smart agriculture.
Landing.impactDesc: Empowering rural communities with actionable decision intelligence that prevents catastrophic crop failure, increases smallholder yields by over 160%, and safeguards national reserves.
Landing.trialDesc: Identical soil, same rain, equal fertilizer — yet the AgriIntel protocol yielded +167% net output simply through precision agronomic timing.
Landing.step1Desc: Planted on Day 4 following 18mm rain threshold.
Landing.step2Desc: AI vision flagged early spore risk 72 hours prior to outbreak.
Landing.step3Desc: Applied urea before 84% absorption rain; zero nutrient leaching.
Landing.ctrl1Desc: Seed planted dry; false start required 30% re-sowing.
Landing.ctrl2Desc: Sprayed 6 days after yellow rust was already visible in field.
Landing.ctrl3Desc: Urea washed off by heavy unpredicted storm within 4 hours.
Landing.quote: “Dividing time and effort to provide quality services to our crops was once guesswork. With AgriIntel voice calls on my simple Nokia phone, I knew the exact morning to spray before stripe rust spread. My teff harvest doubled this season.”
Landing.farmerRole: Commercial Wheat & Teff Producer, Lume Woreda, Oromia
